title.narrative: Kenya Rangelands Ecosystem Services pRoductivity (RangER) Programme

description.narrative: The RangER programme adopts a landscape approach to enhance sustainable productivity of ecosystem services provided by rangelands in the Amaya Triangle counties through investments in evidence-based climate smart pasture and feed resources, an array of climate smart tree- wildlife and natural resource-based livelihoods and promoting effective governance, peace and security for both wildlife and people. It is going to be implemented in Kenyas Amaya Triangle Counties: Isiolo, Laikipia, Samburu and Baringo.
